audit.why: Kled wins 1-2 mounted, evens at 3-4, and Aatrox takes 5 onward once Skaarl can be stripped — consistent with the 49.36% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes said "bait his W attack-speed burst" without saying what ends it.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is explicitly four attacks (13/12/11/10/9s), so the spike ends on a countable number of autos rather than a timer.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and early now say four attacks and give the 11s Q cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kled ultimate was written as "Chaaaaaaarge" (one A short of the real name) in three places.
audit.why: Riot's name is Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and its real lane relevance is the shield plus the lock-on ram, which the text never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Name corrected in spikes[1], wants.foe[1] and late; the shield is now stated.

edits.before: Lane starts to even: don't fight while he's mounted and Skaarl is fresh. Bait his Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) pull and his Violent Tendencies (W) attack-speed burst, then E-Q him once those are down.
edits.after: Lane starts to even: don't fight while Skaarl is fresh. Bait Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, 11s at rank 1) and the four attacks of Violent Tendencies (W), then E-Q him while both are down.

edits.before: Once you've dismounted him, his Chaaaaaaarge (R) is only up when remounted — a dismounted Kled is a squishy melee you crush. Time your all-in for when Skaarl's courage bar is low.
edits.after: Once you've dismounted him, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) only comes back when he remounts — a dismounted Kled is a squishy melee you crush. Time your all-in for when Skaarl's courage bar is low.

edits.before: Use Chaaaaaarge (R) to reset and re-engage aggressively
edits.after: Use Chaaaaaaaarge!!! to reset, shield, and re-engage

edits.before: Kled bullies you levels 1-2. Mounted, he has a ranged Q Bear Trap that pulls you in, a W attack-speed steroid that shreds, and an E dash reposition — that's more early burst than your drain can out-sustain before your kit is online. Don't fight into a fresh mount; soak minimal damage, dodge the Q pull, and farm. Eating a Q-into-W here loses you a big chunk and possibly the wave.
edits.after: Kled bullies you levels 1-2. Mounted, Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) pulls you in on an 11s cooldown, Violent Tendencies (W) gives him four massively fast attacks, and Jousting (E) repositions him — more front-loaded burst than your drain can answer before your kit is online. Don't fight a fresh Skaarl; dodge the Q, soak little, and farm. A Q-into-W here costs you a big chunk and maybe the wave.

edits.before: You scale past him comfortably. Kled is an early-game skirmisher whose power is front-loaded, while Aatrox's drain, R heal amp, and teamfight presence only grow. After your first item, force sidelane duels whenever he's dismounted — your W-pull all-in and sustain grind him down. In teamfights his Chaaaaaarge engage is dangerous, but a dismounted Kled folds to your combo.
edits.after: You scale past him comfortably. Kled is an early-game skirmisher whose power is front-loaded, while Aatrox's drain, R heal amp, and teamfight presence only grow. After your first item, force sidelane duels whenever he's dismounted — your W-pull all-in and sustain grind him down. In fights his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engage is dangerous, but a dismounted Kled folds to your combo.

notes: Content-layer win[] for kled is Kled,Kled,Skill,Skill,Aatrox,Skill,Aatrox while the full-layer level chart reads Aatrox at stages 5-7. The two layers disagree at "First item"; not changed here because stage sides are the applier's/mirror-fix's domain. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's own description does not support (it describes a drag + slow only), so no grounding claim was made anywhere in this slice.
